reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Drilling (52) wells in the Republic of Ghana.

description.narrative: (196,404 direct beneficiaries and 70,758 indirect beneficiaries) obtained water suitable for drinking and personal use, as well as for agriculture and livestock breeding.

1- Contribute to reducing the percentage of diseases resulting from drinking polluted water. 2 - Providing water for agriculture and livestock, on which the population's economy depends 3- Reducing the time to obtain water to 30 minutes for each beneficiary 4- Raising the income level of the beneficiary population by raising the rate of agriculture and livestock breeding by 5%.
Providing safe water sources for drinking and personal use in the areas most in need.
